description: Source file implementing the TouchState class for managing touch input states, including handling pointers, windows, and related input flags within Android's input dispatcher.

classes.name: TouchState
classes.description: Manages the state of touch pointers across multiple windows, including adding, removing, and querying touch pointers and window states.

classes.name: TouchedWindow
classes.description: Represents a window that is currently touched or hovered, tracking pointer IDs, flags, and related input states.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the TouchState to its initial state.

methods.name: removeTouchedPointer
methods.description: Removes a specific pointer ID from all touched windows.

methods.name: removeTouchedPointerFromWindow
methods.description: Removes a pointer ID from a specific window.

methods.name: clearHoveringPointers
methods.description: Clears all hovering pointers from all windows.

methods.name: clearWindowsWithoutPointers
methods.description: Removes windows that have no pointers or hover pointers.

methods.name: addOrUpdateWindow
methods.description: Adds a new window or updates an existing window's touch state.

methods.name: addHoveringPointerToWindow
methods.description: Adds a hovering pointer to a specific window.

methods.name: removeWindowByToken
methods.description: Removes a window based on its token.

methods.name: filterNonAsIsTouchWindows
methods.description: Filters windows to only keep those with specific dispatch flags.

methods.name: cancelPointersForWindowsExcept
methods.description: Cancels pointers for all windows except those with a specific token.

methods.name: cancelPointersForNonPilferingWindows
methods.description: Removes pilfered pointers from windows that are not pilfering them.

methods.name: getFirstForegroundWindowHandle
methods.description: Returns the handle of the first foreground window.

methods.name: isSlippery
methods.description: Determines if the current touch state is slippery (related to window input config).

methods.name: getWallpaperWindow
methods.description: Returns the handle of the wallpaper window if present.

methods.name: getTouchedWindow
methods.description: Retrieves a touched window by its handle.

methods.name: isDown
methods.description: Checks if any pointers are currently down.

methods.name: hasHoveringPointers
methods.description: Checks if there are any hovering pointers.

methods.name: getWindowsWithHoveringPointer
methods.description: Returns a set of windows that have a specific hovering pointer.

methods.name: removeHoveringPointer
methods.description: Removes a specific hovering pointer from all windows.

methods.name: removeAllPointersForDevice
methods.description: Removes all pointers associated with a specific device.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current touch state for debugging.
